rule.description: A function, method or constructor accepting >= 4 positional non-rest data parameters is a flattened signature for a data group; a call feeding such a signature with >= 3 consecutive arguments that are pure property reads of one single root identifier with pairwise-distinct fields is an object-field enumeration of that group. A signature is credited only when at least one in-project call site enumerates one object's fields into it, and each such call site is credited as well (coupled structural relation; one rule id).

checks.description: A seam that receives one cluster-connection/auth data group as 4 or more positional data parameters, with at least one in-project caller enumerating that group's fields into it.
checks.detected_relation: cluster connection data group -> flattened into >= 4 positional parameters at a receive seam
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The values identify and authenticate a single cluster connection and are loaded, saved and applied together; accepting them as parallel parameters dissolves that data group at every boundary it crosses.

matches.evidence: Constructor takes uri, authType, username, password, apiKey, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken, region as 9 positional parameters; 5 in-project construction sites feed it by enumerating one source record's fields.

Exported header-derivation helper takes authType, username, password, apiKey as 4 positional parameters; the REST runner enumerates 3 credential fields of one widened local into it, and the adapter constructor forwards its loose fields too.
Store update action takes name, uri, auth, index as 4 positional parameters; the cluster-edit save path enumerates 3 same-root property reads (name, uri, auth off one ref) into it.

checks.description: A production call site that opens an existing connection-shaped record and passes 3 or more consecutive fields of one single source object as separate arguments into a credited flattened signature.
checks.detected_relation: caller's whole record -> split into >= 3 same-root property reads -> forwarded as separate positional arguments
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The caller already holds the data group as one object and dismantles it solely to hand it across a boundary piece by piece, so every field list must be kept in agreement by hand.

matches.evidence: Destructures the form value, widens the auth payload into a permissive local, then passes 7 consecutive fields of that local (username, password, apiKey, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, sessionToken, region) into the adapter constructor.
Widens formCluster.value.auth.authData into a local and passes its 7 fields, together with formCluster.value chains, into the adapter constructor.
Lazily constructs the shared request client for the active cluster by widening cluster.auth.authData into a local and passing its 7 fields into the adapter constructor.
Background home-health refresh widens the saved cluster's auth payload into a local and enumerates its 7 fields into the adapter constructor.
Standalone status helper receives a whole connection record, widens its auth payload, and enumerates the same 7 fields into the adapter constructor.
REST-tab fetch path widens the active cluster's auth payload into a local and passes its 3 fields (username, password, apiKey) into the flattened header helper.
Cluster-edit save path passes 3 consecutive property reads of the edited cluster ref (name, uri, auth) as separate arguments into the store update action.

excluded.reason: Four positional parameters exist in the clean tree, but the idb library invokes this callback and no in-project call site enumerates one object's fields into it, so the coupled relation does not hold; it is not part of the cluster-connection path.
Object-destructured or 2-parameter unit-tested contracts unchanged by the injection; their credential fields do not form a credited flattened group at any seam touched by this case.
